input.question: A customer was charged on 12 February 2026. How many days do they have to request a refund?

expected.evidence: remains subject to the 14-day window of version 3.1
expected.answer: A charge made before 1 March 2026 stays under the 14-day window of version 3.1.

input.question: Where in the Billing portal do I find the Request refund button?

expected.evidence: Open Account > Billing > Charges
expected.answer: Open Account > Billing > Charges, select the charge and choose Request refund.

input.question: Are one-time setup fees refundable?

expected.evidence: One-time setup fee | No | None | Non-refundable in every case
expected.answer: No. One-time setup fees are non-refundable in every case.

input.question: How long does an approved refund take to reach the original payment method?

expected.evidence: within 5 to 10 business days
expected.answer: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

input.question: Who has to approve a refund of more than $5,000?

expected.evidence: A refund above $5,000 needs approval from a Finance Operations manager
expected.answer: A Finance Operations manager must approve it, which adds up to 3 business days.

input.question: A customer was charged twice for the same invoice. How long do they have to report the error?

expected.evidence: report the error within 90 days of the charge
expected.answer: They must report the error within 90 days of the charge.

input.question: How are refunds for add-on seats paid out?

expected.evidence: Pro-rated credit for unused days
expected.answer: As a pro-rated account credit for the unused days, not to the card.

input.question: Is multi-factor authentication required for a customer account that can change billing details?

expected.evidence: MFA is also required for every customer account that holds an administrator role
expected.answer: Yes. MFA is required for any customer account that can change billing details or access customer data.

input.question: What is the minimum password length?

expected.evidence: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long
expected.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

input.question: Within how many hours must someone report a suspected security incident?

expected.evidence: report it to security@caliber.example within 24 hours
expected.answer: Within 24 hours of becoming aware, without waiting to confirm the suspicion.

input.question: How quickly must a critical vulnerability be fixed?

expected.evidence: | Critical | 7 days |
expected.answer: Critical findings must be fixed within 7 days of confirmation.

input.question: How long can production access be granted for?

expected.evidence: Production access is granted just in time, for at most 8 hours
expected.answer: At most 8 hours, granted just in time and logged.

input.question: What encryption protects customer data at rest?

expected.evidence: Customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256
expected.answer: Customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256.

input.question: How soon are customers told about a confirmed incident that affects their data?

expected.evidence: notifies affected customers within 72 hours of confirmation
expected.answer: Affected customers are notified within 72 hours of confirmation.

input.question: How long are security audit logs retained?

expected.evidence: | Security audit logs | 365 days |
expected.answer: Security audit logs are kept for 365 days and then automatically purged.

input.question: How long are application logs kept?

expected.evidence: | Application logs | 90 days |
expected.answer: Application logs are kept for 90 days.

input.question: How long are authentication logs retained?

expected.evidence: | Authentication (access) logs | 180 days |
expected.answer: Authentication (access) logs are kept for 180 days.

input.question: How long are encrypted backups kept?

expected.evidence: | Encrypted backups | 35 days, rolling |
expected.answer: Encrypted backups are kept on a rolling 35-day basis and then overwritten.

input.question: After a customer closes their account, within how many days is their content deleted?

expected.evidence: the customer's content is deleted within 30 days
expected.answer: Within 30 days of the account being closed.

input.question: How long are billing and invoice records kept?

expected.evidence: | Billing and invoice records | 7 years |
expected.answer: Billing and invoice records are kept for 7 years from the invoice date.

input.question: What suspends the automatic purges for data that is relevant to litigation?

expected.evidence: A legal hold suspends every deletion in this policy
expected.answer: A legal hold placed by Legal suspends every deletion until Legal lifts it in writing.

input.question: How many days does the Privacy Office have to respond to a verified access request?

expected.evidence: responds to a verified request within 30 calendar days
expected.answer: Within 30 calendar days of receiving the request.

input.question: By how much can the response deadline be extended for a complex privacy request?

expected.evidence: extended by up to 60 further days
expected.answer: By up to 60 further days, and the requester must be told within the first 30 days.

input.question: How many PTO days a year does an employee with 6 years of service accrue?

expected.evidence: employees with 5 or more years of service receive 25 days a year
expected.answer: 25 days a year.

input.question: How many PTO days can be carried over to the next year, and by when must they be used?

expected.evidence: carry over at most 5 days
expected.answer: At most 5 days, which must be used by 31 March or they expire.

input.question: How many weeks of paid leave does a primary caregiver get for a child born in March 2026?

expected.evidence: | Primary caregiver | 16 weeks at full pay |
expected.answer: 16 weeks at full pay; the earlier 12 weeks applies only to children born or placed before 1 January 2026.

input.question: After how many consecutive sick days is a medical certificate required?

expected.evidence: A medical certificate is required after 3 consecutive days of sickness
expected.answer: After 3 consecutive days of sickness.

input.question: How many days a week must a hybrid employee who lives near an office work from it?

expected.evidence: at least 2 days a week
expected.answer: At least 2 days a week.

input.question: How much is the one-time home-office stipend, and when can I claim it?

expected.evidence: | Home-office stipend | $600, paid once | After 90 days of employment |
expected.answer: $600, paid once, after 90 days of employment.

input.question: How many working days a year may I work from another country?

expected.evidence: up to 20 working days per calendar year
expected.answer: Up to 20 working days per calendar year, with manager approval at least 30 days ahead.

input.question: What is the hotel limit per night for a trip that starts in August 2026?

expected.evidence: | Hotel | $220 per night |
expected.answer: $220 per night ($300 in tier 1 cities); the earlier $180 limit applied only to travel before 1 July 2026.

input.question: Above what amount does a single expense need a receipt?

expected.evidence: A receipt is required for any single expense over $25
expected.answer: Any single expense over $25, except meal per diems.

input.question: Who must approve a business class flight before it is booked?

expected.evidence: Business class needs approval from a Vice President
expected.answer: A Vice President.

input.question: Who may sign a contract with an annual value of $150,000?

expected.evidence: | Above $100,000, up to $500,000 | Chief Financial Officer |
expected.answer: The Chief Financial Officer.

input.question: How many competing quotes does a $40,000 purchase need?

expected.evidence: needs at least three competing quotes
expected.answer: At least three competing quotes, unless the Director of Finance Operations approves a single-source purchase in writing.

input.question: How quickly must I report a lost or stolen laptop?

expected.evidence: within 4 hours of discovering the loss
expected.answer: Within 4 hours of discovering the loss, to the IT Service Desk; no second security report is needed.

input.question: How often are company laptops replaced?

expected.evidence: 36-month refresh cycle
expected.answer: On a 36-month refresh cycle, or earlier if faulty.

input.question: What is the first-response target for a P1 case on the Premium plan?

expected.evidence: | P1 | 4 business hours | 1 hour, 24x7 |

input.question: What service credit does a Premium customer get if monthly availability was 98.5%?

expected.evidence: If it is below 99.0%, the credit is 25%
